Team access

Give a colleague access to the selected event. They create an account with the email below. A door staff member only sees the Check-in page. A treasurer only sees Contributions (can add and edit payments and expenses, but cannot delete or see guests). A photographer only sees the Photos page: he can upload and delete photos and copy the gallery link to send to clients (the host decides when the gallery is visible). A co-host (the event's host) can manage everything for this one event — guests, cards, messaging, check-in, contributions — but cannot delete the event, delete payment records or add team members. A co-host or photographer must register with a new email that does not already own events. An event tickets seller or Bulk SMS member gets their own account: after they register with the email below they see only that service, sell their own tickets or send their own SMS, and pay their own fee. They do not see this event.

Messaging

Send invitations to all your guests at once by WhatsApp or SMS.

You can edit the message after choosing a template. Each guest’s name, link and door code are filled in automatically.
Placeholders filled in automatically: {{name}} {{table}} {{event}} {{date}} {{day}} {{time}} {{venue}} {{card_type}} {{link}} {{deadline}} {{map}} {{photos}} · Contributors: {{pledged}} {{paid}} {{balance}} {{due}}

Message status

See which messages reached your guests, which are still on the way and which failed.

How sending works

WhatsApp

Messages are sent automatically when WhatsApp Business is connected; otherwise WhatsApp opens on your phone for each guest.

SMS

Sent through the SMS gateway; if it is not connected, your phone's SMS app opens for each guest.

Automatic reminders

One day before the event, guests who have not replied are reminded automatically (when automatic WhatsApp/SMS sending is connected).

Seating plan

Drag guests onto tables (or tap a guest, then tap a table). Changes are saved instantly.

Event photos

Upload photos from the event, share them with your guests and send a thank-you message.

Guest messages

Blessings and congratulations your guests leave when they answer their invitation.

Add a contributor

Record who pledged and how much. If they already paid something, enter it too.

More options (due date, payment reference)
Leave “Pledged” empty if the person just gave money without promising an amount. They are saved as “Gift · no pledge”: their money counts as collected, nothing is owed, and Total pledged stays unchanged.

Contributors

Pledged, paid and balance for every person.

Advanced: transaction ledger and activity log

Transaction ledger

Every money movement in order, with the running balance: payments, reversals, refunds and paid expenses.

Activity log

Who recorded, confirmed, reversed or adjusted money, and why. Only the owner and treasurer can see this.

Budget & expenses

Record what was spent. Expenses marked as paid are deducted from the money collected and appear in every report.

Reports

Summary of guests, RSVPs, invitations and check-ins.

Committee tasks

Who does what, and by when.

Add a task

For example: book the hall, confirm the MC, collect the cake.

Customers

Registered users.

Services and prices

What each service costs, and how customers pay. Customers pay by M-Pesa; you then activate them from their View window.

Photographer subscriptions

Photographers pay a monthly fee to upload photos. After a payment arrives, activate their email here.

Packages and prices

Your packages. Change a price or name any time and press Save. The new price is used for all new quotes; events already agreed keep the limit you set for them.

Package requests

What customers chose when they signed up: package, number of guests and total. After you receive the payment, set the status to Approved and set the guest limit in the table below.

Guest limits per event

Choose the package the customer bought and the number of guests you agreed. You see at once who has added more than agreed. Customers cannot change these settings.

All events

Events from all customers.

Service connections

Status of the services that power the system. Secret keys are stored in Supabase and never appear in the browser.

Supabase

Database, login, storage and data security (RLS).

Connected
WhatsApp Business API

Automatic sending. Requires WHATSAPP_TOKEN and WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID in the Edge Function secrets.

Optional
SMS gateway

NextSMS. Requires NEXTSMS_API_TOKEN and NEXTSMS_SENDER in the Edge Function secrets.
